name: EPIC 211152541
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 11.3 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211152541 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.298225 (16th-84th percentiles 10.956225-11.98436), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,101 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.98 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,810 K at its surface.
